statements.t: Rather than targeting maximum production capacity from day one, we’re prioritizing speed to first production and a lower upfront investment, which is good news for TMC shareholders.
Even at these lower initial volumes, we expect the operation to be EBITDA-positive in its first years.
Our team and external engineering consultants have been in Hachinohe this week working through those plans to make sure our schedules align.
Conference Call We will hold a conference call on November 12, 2026, at 4:30 p.m.
The virtual webcast will be available for replay on the ‘Investors’ tab of the Company’s website under ‘Investors’ > ‘Media’ > ‘ Events and Presentations ’, approximately two hours after the event.
